newsitem.title: USA: Carlson Wagonlit names Tanner as global president.
newsitem.headline: Carlson Wagonlit names Tanner as global president.

text.p: Carlson Wagonlit Travel said Wednesday Travis Tanner will become the president and chief executive officer of its new global organization.
The company said its organization would come into existence once Carlson Companies Inc of Minneapolis and Accor Group of Paris had completed the final merger documents within the next two months.

Tanner will have overall responsibility for Carlson Wagonlit operations around the globe once he takes on his new position, it said, adding that he would have three world region presidents reporting to him.
The company said Tanner had chosen Miami, Florida, as the location for the head offices of the new company.
